==Overview==
* Constructs a [[runeforge]] in Hahnmark, as detailed in the '''[[Snow_might_fall#Five_Tasks|Snow might fall]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==

* 45 wains of weirwood

* 30 wains of mithril
* One year to construct
